# Integration Test Request Structure

The integration test doesn't send specific request structures as it tests existing compiled executables in the output directory. It validates that the syncer.py → Kit-Manager compilation pipeline has been working correctly by:

1. Checking for recent executables in the output directory
2. Running the most recent executable to verify it works
3. Validating the complete production architecture

This test is designed to work with any C++ program that has been successfully compiled through the syncer.py middleware.
